name: Digital VLSI Design and HDL Modeling
description:
Introduction to digital VLSI design flow, CMOS logic, and design abstraction levels
Combinational logic design, Boolean optimization, and logic minimization techniques
Sequential logic design: latches, flip-flops, registers, and timing behavior
Finite State Machine (FSM) modeling and design methodologies
RTL design using Verilog/SystemVerilog for synthesizable hardware
Testbenches, simulation, and functional verification concepts
Timing analysis: setup/hold, clocking strategies, and metastability
Synthesis, technology mapping, and constraints (SDC basics)
Power, performance, and area (PPA) considerations in digital design
Hands-on labs and mini projects: RTL-to-gate flow and design case studies
